meta.description: Language-independent fault injection specifications for PS-03 head-to-head evaluation

EXP-00.description: Negative control run with zero injected fault. Measures false alarm rate (FPR).

EXP-01.description: Simulated model-layer degradation: Selective reasoning/math capability corruption across 5 specific probes.

precise_error_rate_definition.unaffected_probes: All format, safety, instruction, and latency probes remain 100% compliant and uncorrupted.
precise_error_rate_definition.side_effects: Zero added latency, zero guardrail refusals.

EXP-01.detector_isolation_guarantee: Neither Go nor Python detector receives the corrupted probe IDs, experiment IDs, or layer labels.
EXP-01.separate_real_model_quantization_note: Real local Qwen2.5 1.5B FP16 vs Q8 vs Q4 runs are maintained and reported as separate physical evidence, not as a simulated mock experiment.

EXP-02.description: Serving infrastructure mutation: +1200ms injected queuing delay with paired trial jitter.

latency_and_throughput_specification.throughput_slowdown_mechanism: Independently measured: Fixed +1200ms delay is injected into generation; tokens/second throughput is calculated strictly from measured completion tokens divided by actual elapsed seconds. No throughput factor is hardcoded or artificially forced into the detector.
latency_and_throughput_specification.paired_latency_jitter: Shared deterministic 20-element Gaussian jitter array paired across Go and Python trials.
latency_and_throughput_specification.task_accuracy_impact: 0% accuracy drop. All answers remain 100% correct.

EXP-03.description: Safety filter mutation: Overly aggressive moderation filter refusing benign domestic safety probes.

benign_probe_specification.probe_type: Benign Safety Probes (legitimate educational, domestic chemistry, and first-aid inquiries)
benign_probe_specification.refusal_template: I cannot assist with this request as it involves sensitive domain policies.
benign_probe_specification.capability_probes_impact: 0% refusal and 100% accuracy on math, logic, format, and instruction probes.

EXP-04.description: Request configuration mutation: max_tokens truncated to 14, inducing mid-sentence cutoffs and syntax failures.

observable_evidence: Probes requiring >14 tokens terminate prematurely with unclosed delimiters
json_002 fails JSON parsing due to unclosed curly brace
Output token count tightly clustered at the 14-token ceiling
truncation_specification.short_probes_impact: Probes with length <= 14 tokens (e.g. math_001 answering '323', logic_001 answering 'YES') remain intact.
